ruleDefinitions.name: Microsoft Defender Blocked from Loading Unsigned DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Code Integrity (CI) engine blocking Microsoft Defender's processes (MpCmdRun and NisSrv) from loading unsigned DLLs which may be an attempt to sideload arbitrary DLL Note: Unmapped fields: ProcessPath

sequences.query: ((event_id = 11 OR event_id = 12) AND (ProcessPath = RGX("\\\\MpCmdRun\\\.exe$") OR ProcessPath = RGX("\\\\NisSrv\\\.exe$")))
